text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after her scrimmage with Tama
Cross, I come across Oguri
Cap at the
height of an intense training session.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew... Okay, just one more set!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch as her feet gouge the ground,
propelling her forward. There's
no doubt
about it—those legs are a force to be
reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Engulfed by her zeal for training, I lose
track of time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I'm actually gonna be
participating in
the next tryout.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The deadline to apply for the race had
already passed by the time I
had
transferred in.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But after the race coordinators saw the
scrimmage between me and Tama, they
decided to give me special permission to
run in the next
tryout.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I do well during tryouts,
I'll be one step
closer to making my central
debut. I need
to push myself now more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh right. Sorry to keep asking you, but
could you show me the way
one more
time?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anywhere near the school, as long as
there's plenty of nature.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there was such a vast forest
behind the academy. This is
perfect. Thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh,
yes. This is it. The forest air out here
is just right. It cleanses my
mind and calms
my soul.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, I'd always find myself
running in these areas. Eventually, the
folks back home started suggesting I
run in an
Umamusume race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's thanks to everyone back home
and their support.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I remember when I ran in my first regional
race, the townsfolk made me a huge
banner, even though they were really busy
working the
fields...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I had a race, everyone would
gather at the end of the day
and feast in
my name—win or lose.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"What an amazing race!" "Watching you
run is always a treat!" "Keep
at it!" ...I was
always surrounded by words of
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's why... I love running so much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And I love racing too. The bonds it makes.
The joy it brings. I love it
all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone back home always says that
seeing me race—seeing me run
so freely
and happily—means the world to them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And my race with Tama was really fun. Just thinking about it gets my heart racing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If debuting means I get to run alongside
other amazing racers as
strong and fast as
Tama, then...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to debut as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as she reminisces about the past and
contemplates her present,
Oguri Cap's
ambitions shine through brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway,
that's enough chitchat for today. I
should get back to my
training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for bringing me here. I'll come to
this forest to run when I
need to clear my
mind and remember my roots.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking my leave. See you around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap announces her departure and
begins to walk away.
However, as she does
so—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She abruptly stops in her tracks and
crouches over.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Why the sudden change of
expression?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm fine. I just tore one of my
shoelaces, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance down at Oguri Cap's shoes, and lo
and behold, they're worn
down to
basically nothing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal. All of my shoes wear out
quite quickly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gotta go buy a new pair again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap ties the torn laces together and
once again sets off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The damage on her shoes was nothing
short of abnormal, probably because she
runs with such incredible force. Normal
shoes could never withstand that kind of
wear and tear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap won't be able to realize her
fullest potential if she keeps
running in
those.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to do something about it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see everything's as pricey as ever.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey. You're that new trainer, yeah?
The one always hangin' 'round
Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's with the long face? Ya tryna find
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Tamamo Cross about everything that
had happened.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I getcha. C'mon, how'd Oguri not
notice anything till now? She
sure can be a
ditz.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! I'll help ya out.
Tryouts are where
ya go all out! It wouldn't
be fair to the
trainers or herself otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight,
we're pickin' the toughest shoes for
her! Go big or go home!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No biggie. Always glad to help.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
this isn't just for her. If she doesn't
hurry up and debut, how
am I s'posed to
race her again?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's get started! What's your
budget lookin' like? Gotta know
that
before we can do anythin' else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the help of Tamamo Cross, I was able
to pick out a pair of shoes
that can
withstand Oguri Cap's power.
